note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 3.2 ("The next hop for each of these routes MUST be resolvable via the local BGP speaker's Routing Table."). The four tagged functional CI tests (rfc4271-next-hop-kernel.ci, rfc4271-next-hop-kernel-forked.ci, rfc4271-prospective-next-hop-kernel.ci, rfc4271-prospective-next-hop-kernel-forked.ci) run real daemons in both internal and forked bgp-rib placements over TCP BGP sessions. Positive cases prove unresolved higher-LOCAL_PREF inputs cannot become Loc-RIB winners, cover loss withdraws subjects from BGP best, Loc-RIB and all kernel tables, and direct/indirect prospective self-capture excludes and withdraws seeds. Negative cases prove a longer interior host route and independent direct BGP control remain selected in Loc-RIB and installed. Producer rib_next_hop.go (candidateNextHopResolved -> nextHopResolved -> ResolveProspective/prospectiveDistance) enforces the check.
